out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food
violations.observation: A review of the menu with the foodservice operator indicates that there is no consumer advisory for the following food item(s) that may be served raw and/or undercooked: eggs any style for avocado toast on breakfast menu
violations.corrective_action: If an animal food such as beef, eggs, fish, lamb, milk, pork, poultry, or shellfish is served or sold raw or undercooked the permit holder shall inform consumers of the significantly increased risk of consuming such foods by way of a disclosure and reminder using brochures, deli case or menu advisories, label statements, table tents, placards, or other effective written means. A follow-up will be conducted within 10 days.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw shell egg stored above cooked chicken wings in 2 door prep unit.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC placed raw eggs below all cooked items.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: corn (marked 1/5), cooked potato (marked 12/31) in 1 door prep unit; hot brined pickled red peppers (marked 1/5) in Walk In Cooler
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. PIC discarded all items listed.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Plumbing connections at the cold water faucet of the three compartment sink are leaking.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. PIC will repair sink and provide verification of repair to EHS within 10 days.

violations.title: Cooling from Ambient to 41F, No More than 4 Hours
violations.observation: The following food item prepared from ambient air temperature ingredients is not being adequately cooled to 41F or less within 4 hours: SHREDDED MOZZARELLA CHEESE (46F) AND SOUR CREAM (43F) WERE STORED IN VENOR 1-DOOR PREP COOLER OVERNIGHT.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be cooled within 4 hours to 41F or less if prepared from ingredients at ambient air temperature (i.e. reconstituted foods and canned tuna). CFM DISCARDED THE FOOD ITEMS.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: (1) CHICKEN SALAD (40F) PREPARED ON 8/7/2025 WAS STORED IN VENOR 1-DOOR PREP COOLER FOR MORE THAN 7 DAYS. (2) TUNA SALAD (37F) PREPARED ON 8/7/2025 WAS STORED IN WALK-IN COOLER FOR MORE THAN 7 DAYS.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. CFM DISCARDED THE CHICKEN SALAD AND TUNA SALAD.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 2-DOOR PREP COOLER IS OUT OF ORDER.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PLEASE OBTAIN URGENT SERVICE FOR THE UNIT AND FORWARD THE SERVICE REPORT TO EHS WITHIN 10 CALENDAR DAYS.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Parasite Destruction
violations.observation: The following fish offered for service or sale in the ready-to-eat form was not frozen to ensure parasite destruction: CFM IS NOT ABLE TO PRESENT THE PARASITE DESTRUCTION LETTER FOR SALMON AND TUNA.
violations.corrective_action: Before service or sale in ready-to-eat form, raw or partially cooked fish shall be: 1) frozen and stored at a temperature of -4F or below for a minimum of 7 days in a freezer, or 2) frozen at -31F or below until solid and stored at -31F or below for a minimum of 15 hours, or 3) frozen at -31F or below until solid and stored at -4F or below for a minimum of 24 hours. CFM OBTAINED THE PARASITE DESTRUCTION LETTER FROM SUPPLIER IMMEDIATELY.

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device. THE MEASURING RANGE OF CFM’S FOOD THERMOMETER IS FROM 50F TO 550F, WHICH IS NOT SUITABLE FOR MEASURING FOOD MAINTAINED AT 41F OR BELOW.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. CFM ORDERED A NEW FOOD THERMOMETER.
